rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: The head of state sent the Chairman of the State Duma, Sergei Naryshkin, a letter in which, under Article 83(a) and Article 111 of the Constitution, he submitted Dmitry Medvedev's candidacy for the Duma's consent to his appointment as Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation.
rows.locator: Headline, date line (7 May 2012, 14:30) and body

bounded_scope: Chairman of the Government observations for CLAUDE-C01-19 only.
